messages.subject: violin plots revisited
parts:
-----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE-----
Hash: SHA1

I've used the trick described here to do violin plots with ggplot2:

http://learnr.wordpress.com/2009/07/02/ggplot2-version-of-figures-in-lattice-multivariate-data-visualization-with-r-part-3/

(A similar thing is done here:
http://r.789695.n4.nabble.com/Violin-Plot-using-ggplot2-td3417710.html )

but the disadvantage of this approach is that it uses faceting to
separate the violins. This seems to make it quite unwieldy to use the
facets for something else -- for example:

library(ggplot2)
d <-
data.frame(expand.grid(f1=LETTERS[1:4],f2=letters[1:4],n=1:200),y=runif(3200))

ggplot(d,aes(x=f2,y=y))+geom_boxplot()+facet_wrap(~f1)

library(lattice)
bwplot(y~f2|f1,group=f2,panel=panel.violin,data=d)

... someone want to write geom_violin? (eek.)

Ben
